name: tara
description: Explore how drugs change gene expression, pathways and cell states in Tahoe's single-cell perturbation data. Look up drugs, doses, cell lines, genes and drug annotations; retrieve expression, drug-versus-vehicle differential expression, perturbation markers, pathway scores and embedding distance from vehicle. Where available, use a validated signature readout for a cancer process, with its evidence and caveats. Compare responses with annotated mechanism classes or between genotype- or lineage-defined groups of cell lines; explore associations with baseline expression or driver-gene status; and rank relative depletion and cell-cycle effects per cell line across three doses. Capabilities depend on the selected dataset and account. Includes read-only data queries and scientific guidance. For research, not patient treatment. Sign in with your email address or Google.
